content.short: The Working Dead is a Learn-and-Earn platform on Cardano empowering the next generation of Web3 creators.
content.description: The Working Dead is an innovative 'Learn-and-Earn' educational platform designed to foster healthy daily learning habits within the Cardano community. By utilizing the native $WORK token, the ecosystem rewards users for completing educational modules and mastering new digital skills. The platform also provides a sustainable monetization model for content creators, allowing them to share their knowledge while earning from their contributions. With a focus on cross-chain accessibility and career development, The Working Dead empowers its audience to thrive in the decentralized economy.
content.meta: The Working Dead is a Cardano Learn-and-Earn platform for education, skill building, and rewards. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
